per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: No per-object size cap is published; the Commons limit list names 25 repositories and 5 GB per account, with Git LFS disabled.

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention period is stated for repository files; the nightly off-site backup has a 90-day window for disaster recovery, not per-account restore. Free membership has no expiry clock.

egress.terms: No metered egress stated for Commons; instance is 'One shared box on Hetzner ... behind Cloudflare'. Free tier described as permanent, no trial clock.

tooling: Forgejo API, git over HTTPS and SSH, webhooks. Git LFS explicitly NOT enabled (removes one storage pool).
chaining: Provides 5 GB storage per registered account, requiring independent Fjord user registrations for each allocation.
